final: WITH product_stats AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(oi.product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS average_quantity, COUNT(*) AS order_item_count FROM Order_Items AS oi JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), type_stats AS (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(average_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(order_item_count) AS average_order_item_count, AVG(1.0 * order_item_count / (SELECT SUM(order_item_count) FROM product_stats)) AS average_share FROM product_stats GROUP BY product_type_description) SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(average_order_item_count) AS average_order_item_count, AVG(average_share) AS average_share FROM type_stats
